audience.detail: Synthetic project operators who need a bounded, evidence-backed next step without treating a fixture as market proof.
audience.label: Synthetic project operators

baseline.detail: No impact baseline is recorded for this synthetic fixture; analytics work remains explicitly open.

do_nothing_option.detail: Leave this synthetic fixture unqueued; it remains a contract example and makes no external change.

goal.detail: Establish a bounded first research recommendation for a synthetic project without asserting a live-market result.
goal.title: Validate a project research loop

horizon.detail: Use one synthetic contract-validation cycle to decide whether the research route is well formed.
horizon.label: One fixture cycle

non_goals: Publish or change a public account.
Treat synthetic fixtures as real customer research.
research_question: What must be known before a project can receive its first bounded recommendation?

resources.detail: Use only the local fixture workspace and named project roles; no live accounts, paid services, or personal data.

success_signal.detail: Five readiness steps are explicit, research may progress without an invented baseline, and publication remains unavailable.
success_signal.label: A bounded research recommendation
